name: Diligent Industries Limited
about: Diligent Industries Limited manufactures, processes, and trades edible oils, food, feeds, and agriculture commodities in India. It offers refined castor, rice bran, palm, cottonseed, groundnut, and other vegetable, as well as mustard, sesame, and sunflower oil. The company was formerly known as Yatish Securities Limited and changed its name to Diligent Industries Limited in 2012. Diligent Industries Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Denduluru, India.
